facts.fact: ESCCOM's Assistant Director for Cybersecurity says the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act of 2022 (s.52) designated the Eswatini Communications Commission as the national cybersecurity agency.

SWZ.note: Incident response function described but no handled incident or alert stated; critical information infrastructure said not yet declared.

facts.fact: ESCCOM's Assistant Director says the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act of 2022 designated ESCCOM as national cybersecurity agency and gives it regulatory mandate under Section 52.
facts.system: Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act of 2022

SWZ.note: No arrest, charge or figures under the Act stated; ESCCOM says arrests are for law enforcement.
